newsitem.title: EGYPT: EgyptAir building huge maintenance centre.
newsitem.headline: EgyptAir building huge maintenance centre.

text.p: The Egyptian National carrier EgyptAir said on Tuesday it was building one of the largest aircraft maintenance centres in the Middle East and Africa at a cost of 350 million Egyptian pounds ($103.1 million).

Maged el-Masri, head of EgyptAir's technical sector, told reporters the centre - part of EgyptAir's modernisation plan - would be ready by the end of 1998. It would service planes for EgyptAir and other airlines operating in Egypt and other parts of Africa.
"The plan is aimed at setting up an aircraft repair and maintenance centre recognised by the European Union and the U.S. federal aviation authority," Masri said.

"The technical sector's modernisation plan is also aimed at raising the level of air safety and the regularity of planes and to reduce delays," he added. - Cairo newsroom +202 578 3290 ($ = 3.394 Egyptian Pounds)
